correctness.rationale: For each fixed \(N\) and \(P\), every positive-cell confusion matrix is enumerated exactly. All pairwise comparisons through \(N=7\) are exact, yielding no reversal through six and exactly three at seven. The persistent family is certified by closed-form positive differences and polynomial factorizations rather than by extrapolation from computation.

originality.rationale: The literature already establishes formulas, qualitative discordance, and empirical ranking changes between Matthews correlation and \(F_1\). The inspected sources and targeted searches did not state the fixed-prevalence positive-cell minimum \(N=7\), the complete first layer, or the all-larger-size family.
residual_risks: The binary-classification metric literature is large, and an unindexed exercise or software test may contain the same seven-case witness.

value.rationale: MCC and \(F_1\) are established competing binary-classification summaries, and published biomedical work documents metric-dependent classifier rankings. Holding both \(N\) and prevalence fixed isolates the metric geometry itself. The exact smallest positive-cell domain supporting strict disagreement, together with a positive-MCC witness and an all-size continuation family, is a natural benchmark for interpreting and testing biomedical classifier-evaluation pipelines.
